    ma.netinflscore AS reach_score,
    cb.postfreq AS posting_frequency,
    ma.clustsize AS cluster_member_count,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ma.netinflscore DESC) AS influence_rank

SELECT 
    a.accindex,
    ma.netinflscore,
    cb.postfreq,
    ma.clustsize
FROM account a
JOIN profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
JOIN contentbehavior cb ON sb.sessref = cb.cntsessref
JOIN moderationaction ma ON cb.cntref = ma.macntref
WHERE ma.netinflscore > 80
  AND cb.postfreq > 30
  AND ma.clustrole = 'Amplifier'
  AND ma.coordscore > 0.8
ORDER BY ma.netinflscore DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    a.accindex AS account_id,
    ma.netinflscore AS reach_score,
    cb.postfreq AS posting_frequency,
    ma.clustsize AS cluster_member_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ma.netinflscore DESC) AS influence_rank
FROM account a
JOIN profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
JOIN contentbehavior cb ON sb.sessref = cb.cntsessref
JOIN moderationaction ma ON cb.cntref = ma.macntref
WHERE ma.netinflscore > 80
  AND cb.postfreq > 30
  AND ma.clustrole = 'Amplifier'
  AND ma.coordscore > 0.8
ORDER BY reach_score DESC
